subject.title: feat(plugins): expose resolved agentId on plugin command context

question: Should OpenClaw accept `PluginCommandContext.agentId` as a public plugin command handler contract populated from the bound-agent resolver?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but adding or defining a third-party Plugin SDK context field is a product/API contract choice automation should not make.

options.title: Accept and document `ctx.agentId`
options.body: Land the resolver-backed field after adding a short command-author docs note that defines when the optional value is present.

options.title: Decline the context expansion
options.body: Close the PR and keep command authors on existing `sessionKey`, `sessionId`, and runtime APIs for agent/session identity.

options.title: Defer to a broader identity API
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers design a fuller command identity object instead of adding one more optional context field.

recommendation.title: Accept and document `ctx.agentId`
recommendation.body: Land the resolver-backed field after adding a short command-author docs note that defines when the optional value is present.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged plugin-surface work is the clearest maintainer-side history for deciding whether this command-context field belongs in the public SDK.
